title: source.read result
description: The window, and where relocations sit inside it. A window running past the end is reported short rather than refused: a reader looking at the tail of a file is asking an ordinary question, and refusing would make the last screen of every file unviewable.

length.description: Bytes actually returned: the shorter of the request's length and what the source holds from `offset`.

bytes.description: Lowercase hex, two characters per byte.

relocation_sites.description: Offsets within the window at which a relocation sits, when the window came from a hunk. A fact about the image rather than a rendering choice, and what makes a hex view of code readable.
